design.name: Midnight
design.description: A dark-only plum workspace, lavender links and compact geometric controls.
design.guidance: Start in dark mode. Use deep plum surfaces, pale lavender interaction accents, sans-serif headings and compact geometry. This design has no light mode; do not generate one by inversion. Use the bundled local fonts and product compositions. Separate page, panel and inset surfaces; keep metadata quiet but readable. Use the exported page/panel/row spacing and title scale consistently, with 44px action targets and brief 160ms interaction feedback. See docs/polish.md for the complete product contract.
